messages:
Stephanie Nguyen: Heads up: tomorrow’s 10:00am PT demo is exec-attended (Jordan joining). Let’s do last-minute prep + assign roles so it’s clean. Who’s driving vs narrating?

Markus Klein: I can drive in Console + run the API calls. Prefer someone else narrates so I’m not talking + clicking at once.

Stephanie Nguyen: Works. I’ll narrate + handle commercial / next steps. Markus drives.

Jordan Blake: Yep I’ll be on. Please keep it tight + don’t improvise new claims. I’ll jump in for “why Redwood / why now” and then stay quiet unless asked.

Soojin Lee: +1 re: no new claims. Use the v1 talk track phrases where possible. If we get pushed on numbers, stick to “ranges” + redirect to eval.

Talia Benson: Quick logistics:
- Zoom host: Steph
- Start 9:58am PT (we should be on at 9:45 for preflight)
- Agenda: 2 min context, 10–12 min demo flow, 10 min Q&A

Simran Kaur: For flow, suggest we run the known-good order:
1) Streaming chat (fast win)
2) Routing/fallback (differentiator)
3) Cost/latency breakdown dashboard (proof)
4) Optional: tool calling / structured output if time

Colin O'Donnell: +1. I’ll be backup driver if Markus’s VPN/SSO acts up.

Stephanie Nguyen: Great. Can we explicitly write roles + contingency plan here so we all align?

Markus Klein: Proposed roles:
- Driver: me (Console + curl)
- Narrator: Steph
- Exec: Jordan (opening + close)
- Backup driver: Colin
- Demo “tech spotter” watching dashboards: Simran

Jordan Blake: Works. I’ll do:
- 60–90 sec intro (customer pain + what we’re showing)
- 30 sec close (eval + success criteria)

Soojin Lee: If we do fallback live, please narrate it as “policy-based routing with automatic fallback to a compatible variant when constraints hit” (don’t say “never fails”).

Simran Kaur: Contingency plan suggestions (based on the last dry run):
A) If Console is laggy / panels slow to load → pivot to the deck screenshots for the dashboards section. Markus just keeps the API demo going.
B) If streaming disconnects → switch to non-streaming response for the same prompt + mention streaming is best-effort over client connections; server completes.
C) If model output drifts → use canned prompt + pinned model version, and keep the expected output snippet ready in notes.

Rafael Mendes: SRE note: I’m around 9:30–11 PT in case the tenant gets weird. If you see elevated 5xx or throttles, ping me here immediately + I’ll check the demo tenant dashboard + logs.

Stephanie Nguyen: Thanks Rafael. What’s the fastest “are we green?” check 10 min before?

Rafael Mendes: Preflight quick check:
1) Demo Tenant Ops dashboard: error rate < 0.5% last 15m, p95 latency within normal band
2) Quota: no spikes; ensure token budget not near cap
3) Routing rule status: active + last updated not within last 24h
If you want a single link: use the saved view “DEMO TENANT - Preflight”.

Markus Klein: I’ll do a full preflight at 9:35 and post a ✅/⚠️ here.

Talia Benson: Also reminder: please use the reset checklist today EOD so we don’t start with weird state tomorrow. (Seed data + quotas + verify model pins.)

Soojin Lee: For talk track timing: don’t spend >60 sec on the model catalog slide. People tune out. Get to streaming quickly.

Stephanie Nguyen: Agreed. Jordan intro → immediate “let’s hit the API.”

Markus Klein: Here’s the exact curl I’ll run (copy/paste) so we don’t fat-finger live:
```bash
curl https://api.redwoodinference.ai/v1/chat.completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"ri-demo-chat-v1",
    "stream":true,
    "messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant. Answer in JSON."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Extract: name, product, renewal_date from: \"Acme Corp is renewing Redwood Dedicated on 2025-03-31. Contact is Maya.\""}
    ],
    "response_format": {"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name":"extract","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"product":{"type":"string"},"renewal_date":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name","product","renewal_date"]}}}
  }'
```

Simran Kaur: Nice. And for fallback demo, use the “capacity constrained” route toggle we set up (don’t change configs live). Just flip the saved policy.

Markus Klein: Yep. Plan:
- Show route “ri-demo-chat-v1” (primary)
- Flip to saved policy “Demo - Force Fallback”
- Re-run same request, narrate fallback + show trace view

Soojin Lee: Please say “we can pin model versions + quantization profiles” (not “we always run the latest”). Prospect last week latched onto that.

Jordan Blake: Also: if they ask pricing mid-demo, let’s not get sucked in. “We price by usage / reserved capacity; for this workflow we can give a range after we size it.” Then park it.

Stephanie Nguyen: Yep, I’ll handle. I’ll also tee up the close: “next step is a 2-week eval with your prompts + our cost dashboard.”

Colin O'Donnell: Backup plan if auth breaks (SSO loop etc.): I have a service token + can run from my machine and share screen. Just DM me if needed.

Rafael Mendes: If anything looks off tomorrow morning (latency spike), I can temporarily shift demo tenant to the stable pool, but that’s a 5–10 min operation. So earlier ping is better.

Markus Klein: Copy. I’ll join 9:40 PT and start checks. If I see any risk I’ll ping with options.

Talia Benson: Action items before EOD:
- Markus: run reset checklist + confirm model pins
- Simran: verify “Force Fallback” policy still present + trace view works
- Soojin: drop the “safe words for benchmarks/pricing” snippet into Steph’s speaker notes
- Steph: send calendar update with “arrive 15 min early for preflight”

Stephanie Nguyen: Done. Thanks all.

Markus Klein: Preflight now (quick): dashboards look green, quota at ~12% used, routing policy untouched since last week. ✅

Jordan Blake: Perfect. See you all tomorrow 9:45.

Soojin Lee: I’ll be in the Zoom as silent observer. If anything goes sideways I’ll DM Steph.

Simran Kaur: I’ll watch the ops dashboard and keep an eye on the fallback trace panel. :eyes:

Rafael Mendes: I’m around. Ping if you need anything.
